title: Comprehensive Review of Molecular Dynamics Potentials

contributions.purpose: 对代表性分子动力学力场做结构与优劣的横向综述
contributions.mechanism: 逐一给出 CHARMM/AMBER/OPLS/ANI/AMOEBA/ReaxFF/PCFF 的势能函数形式,并按可迁移性/长程作用/数值稳定性/可解释性四轴比较
contributions.evaluation: 定性综述,无实证数字;末尾 Table 1 汇总七种力场强弱与迁移性
contributions.domain: 分子动力学 / 计算化学力场
contributions.source_quote: This paper provides a comprehensive comparative analysis of representative molecular dynamics force fields—CHARMM, AMBER, OPLS, ANI, AMOEBA, ReaxFF, and PCFF—focusing on their structural characteristics, evaluation criteria, and applications in chemistry.

contributions.purpose: 给出按应用场景选力场的实用指南
contributions.mechanism: 按电池/药物研发/催化三大应用领域分别推荐适配力场(ReaxFF/PCFF、CHARMM/AMBER/AMOEBA、ANI/AMOEBA/ReaxFF)
contributions.evaluation: 定性建议,无量化基准;称'2020 年以来 MD 研究在这三领域占比超过 35'(数字被截断)
contributions.source_quote: we ... present practical guidelines to help researchers select the most suitable force field for their simulation objectives

notes: desk-reject。综述类论文,无原创实验/新方法,四元组的 evaluation 无实证数字(定性)。非实证类适配问题:纯文献综述,contributions 由 abstract 归纳。数据/质量红旗:(1)多处引用未解析——'membrane lipid environments ?'(悬空 \cite),药物节参考编号错位;(2)OPLS 1.3 节中段被整段粘贴了 AMBER 的二面角公式与'AMBER scales 1-4 electrostatic...'文字(明显复制粘贴错误/重复段落);(3)'more than 35'句子被截断缺少'%'与后文;(4)所谓'According to Web of Science analysis'统计无出处;(5)参考文献全为无作者的占位式条目(如'CHARMM force field and its applications. (J. Comput. Chem., 1983)')。全文未包含 Agents4Science checklist(会议规定缺 checklist 即 desk-reject,与本文被 desk-reject 一致)。
